items.summary: Kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to validate URL-encoded path segments in the Policy apiCall urlPath, letting namespace tenants bypass the per-namespace clamp and create objects in other namespaces as the admission-controller ServiceAccount — including cluster-wide MutatingWebhookConfigurations, escalating to cluster admin. Fixed in 1.19.1.

A heap-based buffer overflow in F5 BIG-IP APM's Traffic Management Microkernel, reachable through the OAuth authorization endpoint, allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root when a virtual server has both an APM access policy and an OAuth authorization server profile configured.

A directory traversal and file upload vulnerability in Check Point Management Server allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts on the management server. Actively exploited in the wild; added to CISA KEV.

Improper certificate trust validation during VPN negotiation in Check Point Quantum Security Gateway allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the gateway. Actively exploited in the wild per Check Point's Sep 23 advisory; added to CISA KEV.

An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento lets an attacker elevate privileges and take over customer accounts without any user interaction. Added to CISA KEV on Sep 25 with active exploitation observed.
